source.title: Drug-induced lupus erythematosus: an update on drugs and mechanisms
source.whyItFits: Open update on recent drug-induced lupus cases, naming anti-TNF drugs among systemic cases, chemotherapy among subacute cutaneous cases, procainamide and hydralazine NET formation, and improvement after the drug is stopped. Classic anti-histone teaching is not in the text and is not asked.

notes: PMID year confirmed from the PMC record header during download; if the publisher year differs, the PMCID is the file used.
